ui.learn.about.s1: First day at a construction site — everything is new, right?

ui.learn.how.title: How to play
ui.learn.how.loop: Tap the current area (flag) on the map to start. When you finish, the next area opens.
ui.learn.how.preview: First see the work done here and what to watch out for.
ui.learn.how.find: Read the situation sentence and tap the dangerous spot in the picture. If you cannot find it, a hint appears.

ui.learn.how.card: Finished areas become cards. Save them as images to show at TBM.
ui.learn.how.stars: Find without hints for 3 stars; get a badge for each area.
ui.learn.how.pic: If reading is hard, switch to pictures only and tap the speaker button to hear it read.

ui.learn.info.what: An app for people new to construction sites to preview and review site hazards with pictures before work.
ui.learn.info.legal: It does not replace legal safety training (basic construction safety and health training, etc.). It is a tool to review what you learned and get to know the site in advance.
ui.learn.info.self: 3D models, scene pictures, icons, the character and sound effects were made by the project. Outside assets use only free licenses (CC0·MIT·OFL).
ui.learn.a11y.progStars: Stars collected toward the next level
ui.learn.survey.title: Usability survey
ui.learn.survey.intro: 15 questions, 1~2 minutes. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the face that matches how you feel. You can skip and still get the certificate.
ui.learn.survey.sus1: I would like to use this app often.
ui.learn.survey.sus3: This app was easy to use.
ui.learn.survey.sus4: I think I would need help from someone who knows it to use this app.
ui.learn.survey.sus5: The functions of this app fit well together.
ui.learn.survey.sus6: There is too much inconsistency in this app.
ui.learn.survey.sus7: I think most people would learn this app quickly.
ui.learn.survey.sus8: This app is very cumbersome to use.
ui.learn.survey.sus9: I felt confident using this app.
ui.learn.survey.sus10: I needed to learn a lot before using this app.
ui.learn.survey.own1: I could tell what was dangerous by looking at the pictures.
ui.learn.survey.own2: I knew what to tap next without reading text.
ui.learn.survey.own3: I remember the order: stop, move away, report.
ui.learn.survey.own4: I think I will remember today's hazards at the site.
ui.learn.survey.own5: I plan to redo one area at a time before work.
ui.learn.survey.thanks: Thank you! Your answers are saved only on this device and included in "My records → Save result file".
ui.learn.survey.recNot: Not done yet (available after the final check)
ui.learn.top.exitAgain: Press again to exit the app

c.현장에선 늘 안전모를 써요: Always wear a hard hat on site
At the morning TBM (safety meeting before work), a **worker** is standing.
c.턱끈이 풀린 안전모: Hard hat with the chin strap undone
c.안전모는 턱끈까지 조여요: Fasten the hard hat chin strap too
A **worker** wearing a **hard hat** is standing at the TBM.
A worker is standing on a floor with **scrap pieces** on it.
There is a **floor opening** on the structural floor.
A worker stands at the **floor edge** of the 3rd floor and points down.
c.높은 바닥은 고리를 걸고 걸어요: On high floors, clip on before walking
c.근로자가 **생명줄**(안전대 고리를 거는 줄) 옆에서 자재를 들고 걸어: A worker walks with materials next to the **lifeline** (line for the harness hook).
c.자재는 치우고 통로를 비워요: Clear materials and keep walkways open
A worker carries materials toward the **walkway** (path for walking).
c.철근 끝에는 보호캡을 씌워요: Put protective caps on rebar ends
**Rebar** is sticking up from the floor.
c.비계 발판은 빈틈없이 깔아요: Lay scaffold planks with no gaps
c.근로자가 **비계 작업발판**(올라서서 일하는 바닥) 위에서 합판을 옮겨: A worker moves plywood on the **scaffold working platform** (floor you stand on to work).
c.비계 위에선 안전대를 걸어요: Clip on your harness on scaffolds
A **worker** works on the top level of the scaffold.
c.위에서 일하면 아래는 피해 가요: When people work above, go around below
A worker walks on the path under the **scaffold**.
c.작업대 위 안전대 안 건 사람: Person on a lift without a harness
c.고소작업대에서도 안전대를 걸어요: Clip on in aerial work platforms too
A worker works on an **aerial work platform** (machine that lifts people up).
c.이동식 비계는 바퀴를 고정해요: Lock the wheels of mobile scaffolds
A worker is up on a **mobile scaffold** (scaffold on wheels).
c.매단 짐 아래로 다니지 않아요: Do not walk under suspended loads
A crane moves a **bundle of rebar**. A worker walks nearby.
c.자재는 두 줄로 수평으로 들어요: Lift materials level with two slings
A crane lifts a **bundle of lumber**.
A worker pushes a cart toward the **hoist landing door** on the 3rd floor.
c.신호수 없이 움직이는 지게차: Forklift moving without a signal person
c.지게차 곁엔 신호수가 있어야 해요: Forklifts need a signal person nearby
A **forklift** is moving with a load.
c.운반구에는 표시된 무게까지만 실어요: Load the hoist car only up to the marked weight
On the 2nd floor, materials are loaded into the **hoist car** (car for people and materials).
c.리프트 방호울 안으로 들어가지 않아요: Do not go inside the hoist fence
A worker is near the ground-level **hoist fence** (mesh fence around the base).
c.굴착기 도는 범위 안 사람: Person within the excavator's swing area
c.장비가 도는 곳엔 들어가지 않아요: Stay out of where machines swing
An **excavator** is digging. A worker is nearby.
c.덤프와 굴착기 사이 사람: Person between a dump truck and an excavator
A **dump truck** and an **excavator** are side by side.
c.장비 뒤에선 유도자 신호를 따라요: Behind machines, follow the signal person
A **roller** (machine that compacts soil) is moving backward.
c.가파른 흙벽 아래 사람: Person below a steep earth wall
A worker is working at the bottom of a **pit**.
c.안전한 곳에서 신호하는 유도자: Signal person signaling from a safe place
c.동바리가 휘면 바로 피하고 알려요: If a shore bends, move away and report at once
A worker stands under a **shore** (post holding up formwork).
Concrete is being poured onto the **formwork**.
c.동바리는 이어 세우지 않아요: Do not join shores to extend them
c.전선에 가까운 펌프카 붐: Pump truck boom near power lines
c.붐은 전선에서 멀리 두어요: Keep the boom away from power lines
**Power lines** pass over the **pump truck** boom.
A **worker** is welding. Sparks are flying nearby.
c.맨홀은 재고 환기한 뒤 들어가요: Test the air and ventilate before entering manholes
The lid of a **manhole** (entrance to an underground space) is open.
c.벗겨진 전선은 만지지 말고 알려요: Do not touch bare wires; report them
A **wire** is lying on the floor.
c.더울 땐 그늘에서 쉬어요: Rest in the shade when it is hot
On a hot day, a worker is **resting**.
c.방화포와 소화기를 갖춘 용접: Welding with a fire blanket and extinguisher
c.급박한 위험이면 멈추고 피해요: If danger is imminent, stop and move away
c.망가진 안전시설은 바로 알려요: Report broken safety equipment right away
c.위험하면 멈추고, 피하고, 알려요: If it is dangerous, stop, move away and report
This is where the morning safety meeting (TBM) is held when you arrive.
You are standing on the 3rd-floor structural floor.
A site where people work on outside scaffolds and aerial work platforms.
A site where materials are moved with cranes and hoists.
c.굴착기·덤프·롤러가 움직이는 토공사 현장이에요. 흙 둔덕 위에서 내려다보: An earthwork site with an excavator, dump truck and roller moving. You are looking down from a mound of soil.
A site where concrete is poured into formwork.
A hot-day site with welding and manhole work.
c.출입 금지 구역에는 들어가지 않고 피해요: Do not enter a no-entry area; stay away
A short meeting before work where you hear today's tasks and the dangers to watch for.
A hard hat that protects your head. The strap under the chin is the chin strap.
c.안전모가 벗겨지지 않게 턱에 거는 끈: The strap under the chin that keeps the helmet from falling off
Work shoes with a hard toe cap and a thick sole.
c.기둥·보·바닥으로 된 건물의 뼈대예요. 벽과 창문을 붙이기 전 모습이에요: The skeleton of a building: columns, beams and floors, before walls and windows go on.
A hole left in a floor or wall, where stairs, pipes or elevators will go.
c.콘크리트 속에 넣는 울퉁불퉁한 쇠막대예요. 바닥에서 위로 솟아 있기도 해: Bumpy steel bars that go inside concrete. They sometimes stick up from the floor.
Straps you wear on your body with a hooked line. It catches you if you fall.
c.안전대 고리를 거는 튼튼한 줄: A strong line to clip the harness hook to
c.안전대 줄 끝의 갈고리. 단단한 곳에 걸어요: The hook at the end of the harness line. Clip it to something solid
c.건물 바깥에 쇠파이프로 세운 틀과 발판이에요. 높은 곳에서 일할 때 올라: A frame of steel pipes and boards built outside a building. You stand on it to work up high.
c.비계 위에 깔아 올라서는 바닥판: The boards laid on the scaffold that you stand on
A small scaffold on wheels that can be moved. Lock the wheels before climbing.
A machine that lifts a platform (basket) with people on it up high.
A machine with a tall mast and a long arm that lifts and moves heavy materials.
c.자재를 들어 올려 옮기는 일: The work of lifting and moving materials
The person who tells the crane or machine operator how to move, by hand signals or radio.
An elevator that runs up and down a mast outside the building, carrying people and materials.
c.사람·자재를 싣는 칸: The car that carries people and materials
c.땅바닥 둘레를 막는 철망 울타리: The wire-mesh fence around the bottom on the ground
c.한 번에 실을 수 있는 무게 한도: The most weight it can carry at one time
A vehicle that lifts and carries loads with steel forks at the front.
A machine that digs with a bucket at the end of a long arm. Its body turns around.
c.현장에서 굴착기를 흔히 부르는 말: A common site word for an excavator
A truck that raises its bed to tip out soil or materials.
A machine with big steel drums that presses and packs down soil or asphalt.
c.땅을 파고 흙을 옮기고 다지는 일이에요. 파낸 구덩이 옆에 흙벽이 생겨요: Digging, moving and packing soil. Digging leaves walls of soil beside the pit.
A mold that gives concrete its shape when poured. Made of plywood or steel panels.
c.거푸집과 콘크리트 무게를 아래에서 받치는 기둥이에요. 천장 아래에 줄지어: Posts that hold up the formwork and concrete weight from below. They stand in rows under the ceiling.
c.현장에서 동바리를 부르는 다른 말: Another site word for shoring posts
A truck with a long folding arm (boom) that sends concrete up high.
c.펌프카의 긴 팔: The long arm of the pump truck
Joining steel by melting it with a flame. Sparks fly far.
c.용접할 때 튀는 뜨거운 쇳가루 불꽃: Hot bits of burning metal that fly when welding
c.땅속 관이나 공간으로 들어가는 둥근 구멍이에요. 안은 공기가 나쁠 수 있: A round hole leading to underground pipes or spaces. The air inside can be bad.
c.공기가 잘 통하지 않는 닫힌 공간: A closed space where air does not move well
